'''2018 MPC Casey Anis LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2018 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Casey Anis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
